base.head: v7/head.blend
base.note: v7_clips.glb = the v6 base body (tee + shorts + default hair) with every clip, and the hand-modeled v7 head (avatar v7). Sit/Study sit on a seat at seatHeight; Sleep/Defeat lie on the back with the head toward the character's back (+Y Blender, -Z glTF). hand = the socket that holds the weapon.

verbs.note: The verb library (classes v2, design sheet 1.8): the rig and its actions only, loaded in the ruins. impact = phase of the hit key; upper = can play on the upper body; hold = the phase span a held verb loops.
